field recordist.label: has field recordist (recording)
field recordist.definition: Artist explicitly credited with field recording for this recording; a general recording-engineer credit alone does not establish field work.

misc.label: has unspecified contributor (recording)
misc.definition: Artist credited with a contribution to this recording that the source does not classify under a more specific role; inspect the task attribute before interpreting it.

mastering.label: has mastering engineer (recording)
mastering.definition: Artist credited with mastering this recording; this credit does not establish recording or mixing work. The source type is deprecated; retain historical evidence without moving the credit to a release.

recording.label: has recording engineer (recording)
recording.definition: Artist credited with capturing the performance on a recording medium for this recording; does not establish authorship or performance.

balance.label: has balance engineer (recording)
balance.definition: Artist explicitly credited as balance engineer for this recording; a generic engineer credit is insufficient.

booking.label: has booking contributor (recording)
booking.definition: Artist responsible for arranging the recording venue or studio for this recording; does not establish a musical performance.

mix.label: has mixing engineer (recording)
mix.definition: Artist credited with combining recorded tracks into the mix for this recording; distinct from substantially reworking material as a remixer.

sound.label: has sound engineer (recording)
sound.definition: Artist credited with acoustic engineering of the sound reaching microphones for this recording; distinct from equipment-focused audio engineering.

mix-DJ.label: has DJ-mix contributor (recording)
mix-DJ.definition: Artist credited with assembling the DJ mix on this recording; does not imply recording engineering.

audio director.label: has audio director (recording)
audio director.definition: Artist credited with directing the creative realization of the audio project on this recording; not an assertion of video direction or conducting.

artists and repertoire.label: has artists and repertoire (recording)
artists and repertoire.definition: Artist or agency credited with artist development, scouting, or label liaison for this recording; does not imply musical performance.

photography.label: has photographer (recording)
photography.definition: Artist whose photographs are credited as part of this recording; does not establish engineering, composition, or musical performance.

instrument technician.label: has instrument technician (recording)
instrument technician.definition: Artist credited with instrument maintenance or preparation for this recording, including tuning; does not establish playing the instrument.

engineer.label: has engineer (recording)
engineer.definition: Artist credited with general engineering for this recording; no specific engineering discipline can be inferred from this role alone.

audio.label: has audio engineer (recording)
audio.definition: Artist credited with engineering equipment that processes or generates sound for this recording; distinct from acoustic sound engineering.

remixer.label: has remixer (recording)
remixer.definition: Artist credited with substantially reworking existing tracks or samples into this recording; distinct from the original mix engineer.

field recordist.label: has field recordist (release)
field recordist.definition: Artist explicitly credited with field recording for this release; a general recording-engineer credit alone does not establish field work.

transfer.label: has audio transfer engineer (release)
transfer.definition: Artist credited with transferring audio between media for this release; does not by itself establish remastering.

mastering.label: has mastering engineer (release)
mastering.definition: Artist credited with mastering this release; this credit does not establish recording or mixing work.

recording.label: has recording engineer (release)
recording.definition: Artist credited with capturing the performance on a recording medium for this release; does not establish authorship or performance.

balance.label: has balance engineer (release)
balance.definition: Artist explicitly credited as balance engineer for this release; a generic engineer credit is insufficient.

lacquer cut.label: has lacquer cutting engineer (release)
lacquer cut.definition: Artist credited with cutting the lacquer for this release; does not establish responsibility for other mastering stages.

booking.definition: Artist responsible for arranging the recording venue or studio for this release; does not establish a musical performance.

mix.definition: Artist credited with combining recorded tracks into the mix for this release; distinct from substantially reworking material as a remixer.

liner notes.label: has liner-note contributor (release)

booklet editor.label: has booklet editor (release)
booklet editor.definition: Artist credited with editing the booklet of this release; does not establish authorship of the music.

production coordinator.label: has production coordinator (release)
production coordinator.definition: Artist credited with coordinating production of this release; does not by itself establish a producer or performer credit.
